summary.text: Toni Hasenbeck is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 65, which includes Caddo and Comanche counties, and was elected in 2018. In the 60th Legislature she chairs the House Postsecondary Education Committee and is Majority Deputy Leader.

paragraphs.text: Hasenbeck is an alumna of Oklahoma State University and holds a master’s degree from Cameron University.
After college she worked for 19 years as an educator, teaching all ages of children in three school districts.
She is also vice chair of the Appropriations & Budget Education Subcommittee and serves on the Agriculture Committee and the Education Oversight Committee.

sources.title: Representative Toni Hasenbeck (Oklahoma House of Representatives)
